app.name: VI probe (read-only)
app.short_description: Logs VI timing and clock registers
app.long_description: Switches through 480i, 480p, 240p and 1280x240p, measures the real VI timing and logs the Hollywood PLL registers to vi_probe.txt on SD/USB. Writes no clock registers. Returns to the Homebrew Channel when done (about 20 seconds).
